evidence.observation: Stable ~3.15 Torr through ramp at 100 sccm Ar
Monotonic rise 3.19 -> 3.53 Torr during growth, accelerating
MFC reading steady ~100 sccm, so the rise is not from a flow change
T holding 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control nominal
Sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be confirmed or ruled out

args.missing_evidence: Need to tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage: run a rate-of-rise test with Ar off and the tube isolated (rise = leak), or check the exhaust line and pump throttle (pressure drops when cleared = blockage). No normal-run reference for P during growth has been given.
